policy.rule: Extract the unique start2 and target3 from actual input tokens inside the charged answer interval. Compute integer L1 coordinate separation D. If D<182 choose directLP96; if D>=182 execute BP then retain geometry-valid BP or route its invalid output to LP96. Boundary182 is included in BP-first.
policy.excluded_information: No mixture-component flag, generator orientation, source index, shortest distance, labels, prior failures, model votes or numerical outcome enters the dispatch rule. Original numerical acceptance remains separate.
policy.batching: Controls retain consecutive original32-input batches. Candidate classifies actual tokens inside charged per-model preparation, keeps ascending global identities within D>=182 and D<182, executes all high batches then low batches, and scatters actual answers to original identities. True final cardinalities, no padding, duplication, omission or rescue regrouping. Each high batch uses unchanged endpoint_dispatch_batch.run(endpoint_dispatch), executing BP and its required LP96 rescue; each low batch uses the same unchanged function with an empty BP subset. Both groups use the actual original tokens; no model output or shortest label affects packing.
policy.models: The same three immutable shared hidden models and original BP/LP parameter pairs as H2bo/H2bp/H2bq. LP96 core and native BP dynamics/caps/certificates unchanged. All model hashes bound before implementation gate.
policy.readiness: LP96 constructs only its required LP model and float64 copy. Both cascade policies construct BP and LP models and both float64 copies. All3immutable models in seed order0,1,2 and fresh complete readiness for every actual cohort arm; no timed output/model sharing or cached answers across arms.
policy.output_equivalence_gate: Compare every low-D packed answer against independently executed block0 LP96 and every high-D packed answer against block0 always-cascade at its original identity. Check all final states, source choices, hidden steps/couplings, counters, stopping/cap/numerical flags and original-factor margins; normalize and compare complete LP internal trajectories to full LP96 controls. All six repeats of all arms must preserve their predetermined block0 outputs; BP prefix is checked separately. Numerical or batch-dependent disagreement is integrity failure, never silently repaired or dropped.
